cohort: The study included parents of paediatric COVID-19 patients seen in the children's emergency department of KK Women's and Children's Hospital, Singapore, who were discharged for home recovery and received a COVID-19 telemedicine follow-up.
finding: There was a high level of overall satisfaction among parents of symptomatic COVID-19 paediatric patients with the telemedicine consultation, with a mean score of 6.1 out of 7.
followup_time: 10 days (for secondary outcomes of reattendance or hospital admission)
